# Shared diff parser (diff.js) with line data attributes, used by both pages ## What to build Both pages parse and render unified diffs with near-identical copied code: - `src/web/page.html`: `fillDiff(pre, data, path, onLine)` at L744–784, `diffLine` at L736–743, the regex highlighter at L703–735 - `src/suite/page.html`: `fillDiff(pre, d, path)` at L628–655, `diffLine` at L621–627, highlighter at L592–620 - the suite review section also has a cruder `showDiff(file, pre)` (L895–906): raw coloured spans, no line numbers This slice extracts one shared module, `src/web/assets/diff.js`. It holds a **pure** parser (unit-tested in vitest) plus a DOM renderer. Both pages import it and render every diff through it: node diffs in the side panel, the run page's review diff, and the suite page's review diff, which replaces `showDiff`. Every rendered line row carries a fixed set of data attributes (the "rendering contract"). Later work (line-range comments, context expansion) relies on them. The highlighter stays the existing regex highlighter for now, moved into the module unchanged. A later slice replaces it with highlight.js. The look stays the same apart from the theme. The run page's single-line comment click (`onLine`) must keep working exactly as today. The previous slice delivered: - `GET /assets/` on both servers, from `src/web/assets/` (via `serveAsset` in `src/web/assets.ts`) - the `postbuild` copy to `dist/web/assets` - `src/web/assets/theme.css` with tokens, linked by both pages - `allowJs: true` in `tsconfig.json`, so `src/web/assets/*.test.ts` can import `./x.js` - an eslint block turning `no-undef` off for `src/web/assets/**/*.js` ## Context: files to read before implementing - `src/web/page.html` L703–806: - `LOCKFILES`, `isLarge`, `div`, `KEYWORDS`, `tokenRegex`, `highlight`, `diffLine`, `fillDiff` - `loadDiff` (L785–802), `makeRow` (L806–833) - in `fillDiff`, the `.pick` click handler at L753–764 calls `onLine({ line: no, snippet, after: d })`, with `snippet = hunkText.slice(-3).join("\n")` - `src/web/page.html` L602–669: `reviewRow` / `renderReviewDiff`, which call `fillDiff` with `onLine` and place saved comments after `[data-new-line="N"]` (`place()` L612–617). - `src/suite/page.html` L592–735: the copied diff code and the panel's `loadDiff`/`makeRow`. - `src/suite/page.html` L895–925: `showDiff` and the review file list that calls it. - `src/web/page.html` L87–103 and `src/suite/page.html` L84–100: the `pre.diff` / `.dl` / `.ln` / `.mk` / `.tk-*` CSS, which moves to `diff.css`. - `src/runner/changes.ts` L10–17: the `FileDiff` shape `{path, diff, truncated, binary}` returned by `/changes/:id?file=`, `/review/diff`, `/api/changes` and `/api/review/diff`. ## Patterns to follow **Pure parser API:** ```js // @ts-check /** @typedef {{kind:"add"|"del"|"ctx", old?:number, new?:number, text:string}} DiffLine */ /** @typedef {{oldStart:number, oldLines:number, newStart:number, newLines:number, header:string, lines:DiffLine[]}} Hunk */ /** @typedef {{path:string, oldPath?:string, status:"A"|"M"|"D"|"R", hunks:Hunk[], binary:boolean}} ParsedFile */ /** Parses one file's unified diff text (git headers skipped). */ export function parseFileDiff(path, text) { /* ... */ } /** Parses a multi-file `git diff` (splits on "diff --git"). */ export function parseUnifiedDiff(text) { /* returns {files: ParsedFile[]} */ } ``` - Handle `\ No newline at end of file`: skip it. - Handle `@@ -0,0 +1,3 @@` (a new file) and `+++ /dev/null` (a deleted file, status `D`). - Handle a `@@` header with a function context (`header` keeps the text after the second `@@`). - Handle CRLF. **Renderer:** ```js /** Renders a parsed file into `pre` (class "diff"); returns the row elements. */ export function renderDiff(pre, file, { onLine } = {}) { /* ... */ } ``` Each row: ```html
40
41
+
…
``` - `data-old-line` is `""` on add rows, and `data-new-line` is `""` on del rows. - Hunk header rows get `class="dl hunk"` and `data-hunk`. - Keep the old `onLine` behaviour: when `onLine` is given, the new-number cell of add and ctx rows gets `.pick`, and a click calls `onLine({ line, snippet, after: row })`. The snippet is still that line plus up to 2 earlier lines in the same hunk. - Binary, truncated and empty files show the same notices as today. **Highlighter:** move `tokenRegex`/`highlight`/`KEYWORDS`/`HASH_COMMENT` into `src/web/assets/highlight-lite.js` unchanged, and export `highlight(text, path)`. `renderDiff` uses it. ## Step-by-step tasks ### CREATE `src/web/assets/diff.js`, `src/web/assets/highlight-lite.js`, `src/web/assets/diff.css` - **IMPLEMENT**: - `diff.js`: the parser and renderer above, plus `isLarge(path, file)` and `LOCKFILES`, moved from the pages - `diff.css`: the diff CSS from both pages, unified on the tokens in `theme.css` - **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets` ### UPDATE `src/web/page.html` - **IMPLEMENT**: - make the main `
